summary: Cooperstown (Fauquier) tower in Fauquier County, listed as gone; the sources read say nothing about its build, staffing or site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source read describes what remains at the site.

evidence.supports: Association county list: Cooperstown (Fauquier) at 38.52661, -77.56421, status Gone, in Fauquier County
Forest Lookouts Virginia list: Cooperstown entry under the county (the list spells it Fauqier)

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: name, county and coordinates match the Association county list; status Gone is right. Only two lists were found. The Forest Lookouts Virginia list has no detail page for this tower and spells the county Fauqier. Searches and the cache turned up no build year, staffing, fire or present-day site information, so none is stated and access is not set. A check of Fauquier County or Virginia Department of Forestry records could add the history. Confidence low.
